Type: rug
Name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Contemporary Chevron Runner Hallway Rug, 7' 6" x 2' 3", Grey
Colors: Grey
This modern rug brings sophistication to any room with its graceful interlocked chevron pattern. Low- and high-pile loops are combined to create a three-dimensional look and feel. The durable fabric is ready for high-traffic areas. 7' 6" x 2' 3" High-low medium pile is easy to clean Pair with rug pad (sold separately) Ships tightly rolled in a protective bag
